source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of line graphs (PDF 146-147).

blocks.text: Line graphs nuqte bana kar unhein line se jor kar waqt ke saath rujhan dikhate hain, jis se tabdeeli aasani se nazar aati hai, maslan din ya hafte bhar darja-e-hararat kaise charhta utarta hai.

blocks.prompt: Paanch dinon mein stall ki kamai dikhane ke liye line graph behtar hai ya bar chart?
blocks.explanation: Line graph, kyunke din waqt ka silsila hain aur line 500 se 1,300 rupay tak barhta rujhan dikhati hai.

items: Line graph: waqt ke saath rujhan.
